subject: def-fd-conservation-system
description: Candidate-dependent integrability of test integrands could erase all nonzero initial test traces and admit a singular Burgers solution for arbitrary initial data.
correction: Native final-adjudicator imposed state/flux absolute integrability on compact initial slabs and required the initial identity for every boundary test, retaining the interior definition, entropy conditions and absence of a strong-trace assertion.
native_reported_decision: For F(z)=z²/2 and U=x/t on (0,1)×(1,2), U_t+(F(U))_x=0. Write a smooth test as b(x)+t a(x)+O(t²). Even if the old filter requires only the combined integrand to be integrable, its t^(-2) coefficient is x² b_prime/2, forcing b_prime=0 and hence b=0 by compact spatial support. Its t^(-1) coefficient is x a+x² a_prime/2, forcing (x²a)_prime=0 and hence a=0. Thus admitted tests are O(t²), and integration by parts gives zero bulk integral because U(epsilon)phi(epsilon)=O(epsilon). The initial term vanishes for every U0. Repaired by requiring state and flux integrability on every (0,tau)×K and the identity for every initial-boundary test. The singular field now fails the solution-class condition.

native_repaired_review.reason: Reviewed the current definition and all four direct suppliers. The added state/flux slab integrability bounds each test integral by its derivative supremum times a finite L1 integral. Each compact initial-boundary support lies in [0,tau]×K; U0 is locally integrable. Every test is now required. Entropy slab integrability, signs, compatibility, state domain, bilinear pairing and interior distribution formulation are preserved. No strong initial trace or physical assertion is introduced. This is the assigned repair review, not an independent review of my own repair.

subject: pthm-fd-conservation-jump-laws
description: Positive temperature on each open side and C1 extensions of temperature/heat flux do not imply a trace or C1 extension for their quotient; the entropy jump could be undefined.
correction: Native final-adjudicator imposed the missing quotient extension only for the entropy characterization, retaining all three conservation equivalences and permitting zero temperature traces when the quotient itself extends.
native_reported_decision: Open-side positivity of T does not imply traces of q/T. At a stationary plane take T=x3^4 and tangential q=(x3^4 sin(1/x3),0,0), extended by zero at the plane. Both are C1 up to each side, but q/T has no trace. With rho=1 and u=e=s=b=r=sigma=0, every side and weak balance holds; the displayed entropy jump is undefined. Repair retains all conservation conclusions and adds the missing C1 extension assumption only to the entropy characterization. Its source remains merely locally integrable, handled by a zero-source integration identity and a thin-tube integral bound.

native_repaired_review.reason: Checked all conservation triples against the C1-extension hypotheses of lem-fd-weak-jump-consistency, the graph conormal signs, scalar and momentum contractions, and both implications. The entropy current now meets those hypotheses; its source is added to the supplier’s zero-source integration identity. The L1 thin-tube estimate proves necessity of the entropy sign without bounded source traces. Positive temperature traces suffice but are not required when q/T extends. Original conservation conclusions, vacuum cases, Countable Choice and independent initial-data terms remain intact. This is the repair author’s current check, not independent review of the repair.
